Originated at Pixar, now an Academy Software Foundation project. A Timeline holds a Stack of Tracks holding Clips, Gaps, Stacks, Tracks and Transitions, with markers, timing and metadata — the only publicly governed schema that describes an edit as data. The nearest thing in open source to a machine-readable shot grammar.
